subject.title: BL-shipping-costs-11: la urgencia de ventas de marketplace se infiere del importe de envío y no del flag del marketplace

question: Which marketplace service-level codes should map to `ShipPriority.URGENT`, `NORMAL`, or fallback-by-price for eBay, Fnac, CDL, Discogs, AbeBooks, and TodoColeccion?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the correct SLA mapping is a Marketplace/business contract rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Define mappings first
options.body: Marketplace owners provide the provider-by-provider service-code table and fallback policy, then implementation can update formatters and BL artifacts safely.

options.title: Keep thresholds temporarily
options.body: Current behavior remains documented while the team accepts ongoing false positive/negative urgency risk until provider contracts are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Define mappings first
recommendation.body: Marketplace owners provide the provider-by-provider service-code table and fallback policy, then implementation can update formatters and BL artifacts safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The parent BL issue identifies PabloMoran34 as the owner for this block, and this issue says the owner validated the desired behavior.
